primitives.name: Read-Only Modular Context Protocol Server
primitives.verbatim_quote: GSE lens The genuinely good idea here is the *read-only MCP server* for context packaging — a safety property GSE's fleet should want (agents that can read context but not mutate the repo through the tool).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'contextual embedding space (dimensionless)', 'M': 'modular protocol interface (dimensionless)', 'S': 'state transition function (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Agent operates within a closed-loop system where external mutation is prohibited; context is preprocessed into a static vector space.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S(C) fails due to unauthorized write access or dynamic context drift.

layer2.mapping: MCP server maps to GSE's context abstraction layer, where C represents a fixed-point embedding of repository state. S acts as a deterministic state transition operator over C.
layer2.telemetry: Observable via agent-read-only flag and context integrity hash.

primitives.name: Modular Contextual Embedding
primitives.verbatim_quote: Vision Turn any folder/codebase into clean, AI-ready context — GUI, TUI, CLI, and a read-only MCP server — with an interactive file tree, live preview, and export as ASCII/Markdown/JSON/XML (or a filtered folder/ZIP copy).
primitives.assumptions: Each F is mapped into E such that T(F) ≤ T_max; E is invariant under read-only operations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T(F) exceeds threshold or F contains non-representable structures.

layer2.mapping: E = f(F) where f is a kernel function that preserves semantic fidelity while reducing dimensionality. Kernel is derived from tokenized file content and metadata.
layer2.telemetry: Tokenized file size and embedding dimensionality.

primitives.name: Agent Safety Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: Verdict IGNORE — gitingest covers the context-packaging need; the read-only MCP property is worth copying as a one-line design constraint, not a reason to adopt a C# desktop app.
primitives.assumptions: A is constrained by R such that C(A) remains constant across time steps.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure when R is bypassed or A modifies C without authorization.

layer2.mapping: Agent safety is modeled as a constraint set {R = 1} ⊆ {A ∈ A | C(A) = const}. This mirrors GSE’s agent-state safety kernel.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of context integrity post-agent interaction.
